title: Context Engineering for AI-Assisted Pharmacometrics: A Practical Tutorial
evidence_scope: Indexed primary full-text sections: task library, architecture, data availability
application: Organize tasks with domain rules, verification criteria, dependencies and file-based handoffs
limitation: Our context schema and planning software are adaptations; the tutorial does not validate their accuracy

title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
evidence_scope: Primary abstract and prior method discussion
application: Decompose generated claims and check whether their full meaning is supported by a source
limitation: Custom review contracts only; no FActScore package, benchmark results or calibrated accuracy are reproduced

title: Summary of a Haystack: A Challenge to Long-Context LLMs and RAG Systems
evidence_scope: Primary abstract and prior method discussion
application: Assess expected source information coverage separately from evidence support
limitation: Our proposal inventory needs its own review and is not known benchmark ground truth; no SummHay score is claimed

title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Compression and Selective Augmentation
evidence_scope: Primary abstract, prior conversation implementation review
application: Select and compress information according to the downstream question
limitation: The trained RECOMP models are not installed or reproduced; this software uses structured generation and review

title: LLMs Can't Plan, But Can Help Planning in LLM-Modulo Frameworks
application: Generate candidate plans, check them externally, and use explicit feedback for bounded revision
limitation: A design reference, not proof that graph checks establish scientific validity

title: Common Workflow Language Workflow Description v1.2.1
application: Represent inputs, outputs and dependencies explicitly and derive connections from file producers and consumers
limitation: The emitted JSON is a custom planning contract, not an executable CWL document

title: Model-Informed Drug Development for Antimicrobials: Translational PK and PK/PD Modeling to Predict an Efficacious Human Dose for Apramycin
evidence_scope: Primary indexed full text and local review/supplement inventory from 2026-09-15
application: Animal compartmental PK and allometric human PK prediction linked to preclinical pharmacodynamic evidence
limitation: Use its translation structure, not its parameter values, for another drug. Complete raw data and estimation code were not confirmed public in our review

title: Pharmacokinetics and Renal Disposition of Polymyxin B in an Animal Model
evidence_scope: Prior primary-source review recorded in local literature index
application: Starting example for animal compartmental PK and distinguishing systemic from tissue disposition
limitation: The paper does not validate animal-derived human PK prediction; individual raw data and executable code were not verified

title: BWC0977, a broad-spectrum antibacterial clinical candidate to treat multidrug resistant infections
evidence_scope: Prior primary-source review and local source-data inventory
application: Animal PK scaling followed by comparison with observed phase I human PK
limitation: Good human PK agreement does not validate clinical response. Published corrections must be checked. Complete animal data and executable PK code were not confirmed

title: How many subjects are necessary for population pharmacokinetic experiments? Confidence interval approach
application: Plan sample size by simulating the probability of achieving specified parameter-CI precision under an explicit PK model and sampling design
limitation: No universal number of animals or species; precision does not establish accuracy of human extrapolation

title: Interspecies prediction of human drug clearance based on scaling data from one or two animal species
evidence_scope: Prior primary abstract/method review; full validation data not independently reanalyzed
application: Candidate calibrated one- or two-species CL scaling comparator when the drug and available species match its scope
limitation: Historically calibrated using other drugs' human PK; not a universal exponent and not a complete human concentration-time model. See MAHMOOD2009

title: Role of fixed coefficients and exponents in the prediction of human drug clearance: how accurate are the predictions from one or two species?
application: Include a critical comparator and check method implementation, disposition, CL versus CL/F and validation dataset matching
limitation: Reported disagreement is evidence of limited generalization, not proof that adding a species always improves prediction
